verdict.rationale: Superpowers is driven through ordinary chat with the coding agent. Skills auto-trigger from plain requests ("Fix this bug" routes to systematic-debugging), brainstorming draws the spec out of conversation, and implementation starts "once you say 'go'"; slash commands such as `/brainstorming` are an optional extra. A community user confirms the conversational workflow, including simply telling it to go after reading the design doc. Missing for 10: independent hands-on verification that natural-language auto-triggering works reliably (the author says it only "should" default into planning), as the runtime probe tested installation only.
